product_one_liner.value: Cast AI automates Kubernetes and AI infrastructure optimization, including autoscaling and resource rightsizing, for engineering, DevOps and SRE teams seeking reliable performance and lower cloud costs.

pricing_page.notes: Cast AI’s Kimchi product publishes Coder, Teams and Enterprise plans with public pricing; the core Cast AI pricing URL is only a custom-quote page, not a public plan/pricing schedule.

eng_blog.notes: Augustinas Stirbis, VP of Software Engineering, describes Cast AI’s multi-cloud networking/control-plane architecture and its internally developed Terraform provider in two engineering posts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router), among other ML and data-science roles.

model_provider.notes: Cast AI explicitly announced MiniMax M3 availability in its Kimchi Coding product; the product page identifies M3 as replacing M2.7 as the default builder. This does not identify the model behind CastPilot/OpsPilot.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names these audits/certifications. GDPR compliance language is not treated as a separate certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 12, 2026, from Pacific Alliance Ventures. The investment amount was not disclosed; the reported valuation above $1 billion is not the amount raised.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 12, 2026 strategic funding announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live posting is Business Development Representative | French Speaking; the board also lists Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Kimchi Coding reached general availability on July 15, 2026. Database Optimizer general availability was announced October 22, 2026; both fall within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Reid Barker announced joining as VP of North America on April 10, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Job-post signals, not a verified deployment inventory: Salesforce campaign/admin work and Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Crunchbase research are explicit duties. Other tools appear in marketing-tool requirements or integration/familiarity examples. The Sales Ops and GTM Systems mirrors are historical, not evidence that those roles remain open.
